headline: Alarmed by Public Anger, Ruling Party: "Don't Distinguish Non-Resident One-Home Owners"
summary: Democratic Party leader Kim Min-seok called for supplementing the government's real estate tax reform plan for non-resident one-home owners. The party also took a cautious stance on changes to tax deductions.
why: Real estate tax rules in South Korea affect housing demand, property values and the tax income of local and national governments.
